families.rule: A closed D1 bar is NR7 when its high-low range is <= every one of the previous six closed D1 ranges. During the next broker date, inspect only the first 32 existing M15 bars. The first close >= NR7 high + 0.10 M15 ATR is LONG; the first close <= NR7 low - 0.10 M15 ATR is SHORT. One event maximum.

A closed H4 bar is inside the immediately previous closed H4 bar: high <= previous high and low >= previous low. In the next 16 existing M15 bars, the first close >= inside high + 0.10 M15 ATR is LONG or <= inside low - 0.10 M15 ATR is SHORT. One event maximum.

A closed H4 bar is outside the previous H4 bar. If it closes in the top 20% of its range, the first of the next 16 existing M15 closes below the outside-bar midpoint triggers SHORT. If it closes in the bottom 20%, the first close above the midpoint triggers LONG.

The last two closed D1 bars have opposite body signs and each absolute body is >= 0.20 of its own D1 ATR14. On the next broker date, the first four existing M15 bars define an opening range. In the next 12 existing M15 bars, only a close break in the direction of the most recent D1 body is eligible: >= range high + 0.10 M15 ATR for LONG or <= range low - 0.10 M15 ATR for SHORT.

anti_overfit: Exactly four families and one configuration each.
No post-result direction, month, volatility, weekday or year rescue.
No rule changes between temporal slices.
MT5 orders, live trading, live-ready, final signal and Discord remain OFF.
